desc: Split p on its two '*' into segments A, B, C (each may be empty).
Implement KMP to enumerate all overlapping occurrence start indices of each nonempty segment in s in O(n + |seg|).
Build suffix-min next-occurrence arrays nxtB and nxtC of size n+2 (INF sentinel), giving smallest start >= i; treat an empty segment as occurring at every position (handled inline with b=p1 / c=p2).
If A nonempty iterate occ_A starts, else iterate all i in 0..n; chain p1=i+len(A) → b=nxtB[p1] → p2=b+len(B) → c=nxtC[p2]; when b,c finite update answer=min(answer, c+len(C)-i).
Handle edge cases: all segments empty (answer 0), adjacent/non-overlapping segments, positions near boundaries, and return -1 when no valid candidate exists.
Validate against examples (8, -1, 0, 6) and confirm O(n + m) time and correctness of the earliest-B/earliest-C greedy.
